description: Post-inference, hash-paired original synthetic corpus; all failures and unsupported cases retained. No general accuracy claim.

corpus.license: CC0-1.0 original compositions and generator; tooling licenses separate

method.path: Actual staff detection, optional skew rectification, cropped pixels, local ONNX/WASM, strict token parsing
method.selectedReadingOrder: Single-voice regions in declared reading order; multipart kept separate; no gap filled from truth
method.alignment: Unit-cost Levenshtein pitch alignment plus full note/rest/onset/duration alignment; source part ordinals are fixed
method.fullExactCase: Supported source only; zero full event edits; initial clef/key/meter and part count correct
method.durationAndOnsetDenominator: Expected notes312 in supported stratum; correct values counted only among pitch matches; unmatched/extra notes also reported
method.rests: Rest identity, onset and duration are included in full event alignment
method.draftState: All automatic targets unverified; no Tempo/held scoring before explicit rhythm verification

privacy.modelInputs: Pixels, dimensions, crop transform/offset and page only; no filename/source text/truth supplied to model

browserRoundtripStatus.coverage: Actual PNG and raster-only PDF inference/save; predicted duration retained; completed selection/order/support inputs locked until explicit discard; explicit correction/review; simulated MIDI Wait/Tempo; canonical per-instrument sessions; reload/provenance. Controlled replies separately test lifecycle failures.

audiveris.task: Whole raster to MusicXML, stricter written-score structure metric; not the selected-region browser path
audiveris.shippingStatus: Not bundled or deployed; Java/native CLI does not run unchanged on static Pages

homr.task: Whole raster to MusicXML, stricter written-score structure metric; not the selected-region browser path
homr.license: AGPL-3.0 code/weights; upstream FAQ flags PrIMuS noncommercial/unclear training pedigree
homr.shippingStatus: Not bundled or deployed; no commercially unrestricted weight-redistribution claim

limits: Original synthetic engraving with controlled degradation, not real scan/camera/handwriting accuracy.
Clean/degraded pairs share20 compositions; they are not40 independent songs.
No training was performed here, so no development/test split is claimed. Corpus changes or tuning require retaining prior failed runs.
Unsupported chords/repeats/multipart/tuplets are separate; matching their visible notes is not proof of full structure/playback support.
Initial clef/key/meter graded per source staff; later attribute changes and unsupported repeats are not invented.
Pitch edit alignment and full note/rest/onset/duration edit alignment are both exposed. Insertions/deletions/errors are retained.
All drafts remain unverified; raw token scores are not calibrated accuracy.
Unsupported eligibility cannot always be detected automatically from pixels; explicit monophonic selection and manual review remain required.
Earlier32case results used a changing corpus and are excluded as final evidence; all failed outputs remain in cloud audit history.
Companion CPU metrics are separate engine/path evidence and not a browser deployment proof.
Independent GitHub API tree re-fetch was blocked HTTP403; primary pinned license pages, copied source blob hashes and npm integrity were checked.
